deadline.value: The fellowship deadline is January 1, 2027; the general international fall deadline on the same page is April 15.

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are required, with at least the 65th percentile in Quantitative Reasoning.
gre_general.quote: GRE general test scores - Institution code 5815, Department code 0402 | Applicants must rank in the 65% percentile or higher in the Quantitative Reasoning test

toefl_min.value: The department sets a TOEFL internet-based minimum of 92, on the old scale; its page is dated.

ielts_min.value: The department sets an IELTS minimum of 6.5.

supervisor.value: Students must find a research supervisor by the end of their second semester, not before admission.
supervisor.quote: By the end of the second semester, the student must find a research supervisor

funding.value: The page says assistantships go only to PhD students, but does not say most or all admitted students get one.
funding.quote: Assistantships are offered only to PhD students

entry_route.value: The CS pages do not say whether a master's is needed for the PhD.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: The CS admissions page appears to be old (search metadata indicates it was indexed years ago); confirm the GRE, TOEFL and deadline rules with the CS Director of Graduate Studies before relying on them.
